narrative:
Market access gates the ramp. On average 78% of eligible patients have funded access across brands and markets, but the spread is wide: above 90% in the US and Japan, versus 38-61% in China and Emerging Markets for newer indications.

Europe is the swing region. Ultomiris gMG sits at 74% access with a 14-month average time-to-reimbursement, and EU Joint Clinical Assessment timelines will shape FY2026. Managed entry agreement templates from aHUS can be reused.

In China, the Koselugo NRDL listing is the single largest access lever in the plan.

signals.title: EU Joint Clinical Assessment Readiness
signals.excerpt: JCA plus national HTA re-assessments imply 4-6% net price pressure for complement inhibitors in Europe.

signals.title: Koselugo China NRDL Listing
signals.excerpt: Koselugo on the NRDL from January; 38 additional tertiary hospitals onboarded for paediatric NF1-PN.

signals.title: Planning Platform Containment Memo
signals.excerpt: Containment mode: no net-new finance platforms. Rare disease planning pilot runs on existing Snowflake actuals and retires one standalone planning platform.
